name: Cargo Bay
narrativeOnEnter: Stacked containers, magnetic clamps, a loading rail overhead. One section is blocked by a freight security lock — four-position switch, red light blinking. Beyond it, a passage to the reactor deck. A clipboard with a freight manifest hangs on the wall.

hotspots.label: Reactor Deck
hotspots.lockedMessage: Freight security lock is engaged on this passage. The lock switch sequence is on the cargo manifest.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION — CARGO MANIFEST
Delivery Ref: MA-7743-C

Freight security lock sequence for this section:
Switch positions must be set HIGH, HIGH, LOW, LOW
(Positions 1–4)

Note from logistics:
'This sequence was changed after the last incident.
Do not reset to default.'

The switches engage a magnetic clamp release on the passage to Reactor Deck.

───
On the back of the manifest, Kovalev's handwriting:

'Delivery Ref: MA-7743-C.
I looked up the origin. HELIOS GROUP subsid account.
HELIOS GROUP is AXIOM.
AXIOM chartered this station. Funded the mission.
Paid every one of our salaries.
We were never colonists.
We were subjects.

On the lading manifest — buried in the appendix, page 9, line 47:
"CALLISTO — monitoring frequency: 148.350 MHz"
Someone flagged it. Someone on the inside wanted us to find it.
CALLISTO knows. They're watching.
They know what AXIOM does with what they collect.
They know about Blackwood. About PROMETHEUS.
About all of it.

If MERIDIAN-3 boards this station: they are not rescue.
Contact CALLISTO first.
148.350 MHz.
— D.K.'

Sealed cargo containers, secured with magnetic clamps. Labels read:
'REACTOR COMPONENTS — HANDLE WITH CARE'
'MEDICAL SUPPLIES — COLD STORAGE'
'PERSONAL EFFECTS — CREW ROTATION 7'

One container stands apart. No magnetic clamp. Seal already broken — from the outside, recently, by someone who knew what they were looking for.

Label: 'AXIOM BIOTECH — NEURAL MAPPING ARRAY (BATCH 7) — CONFIDENTIAL'

Inside: packing foam cut to hold six cylindrical devices. The devices are gone — only the foam remains.
A packing slip is attached to the lid:

'Addressee: MERIDIAN STATION ALPHA
Shipping auth: HELIOS GROUP (Ref: HG-7743-SRR)
Attn: Station Maintenance (DO NOT DISTRIBUTE)
Handle with care — equipment pre-calibrated for crew biometrics on file.
6 units. Install per diagram enclosed. Activation: automatic on station power-up.'

Kovalev has written in pencil on the inside of the lid:

'I found them. Every bunk. Behind the vent panels in the walls.
They've been running since Day 1.
63 days of data. All six of us.
This is what AXIOM does.
This is what they did at Blackwood.
This is what they built PROMETHEUS from.
I'm not letting them do it again.'
